title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
NHS Digital is seeking a Lead Data Engineer to build and maintain critical health data pipelines. You will work closely with clinicians and analysts to deliver data products that improve patient outcomes.

Requirements:
- 4+ years data engineering experience
- Strong Python and SQL skills
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or GCP)
- Knowledge of data governance and GDPR
- Experience with Apache Spark or similar big-data frameworks

This role is open to candidates who require a Certificate of Sponsorship.
